name: Valkyrie the XVIII
source:
The main villain of the story and [url=/c64097]Yuusaku's[/url] sex partner. She sends her minions to fight the magical girls and has an eye for Masaharu. She forces Yuusaku to dress as a girl.

[spoiler]In one route she betrays Yuusaku to become Masaharu's girlfriend and live a normal life.[/spoiler]
